name: Oakhaven Secured
description: The village of Oakhaven has been secured from the wolf threat.

narration_hooks.template: The people of Oakhaven breathe easier now that the wolves have been driven off.

name: Ancient Knowledge Restored
description: The ancient artifact has been recovered from the Whispering Caves.

narration_hooks.template: Scholars pore over the ancient artifact, revealing secrets of the old world.

name: The Dragon's Fall
description: The dragon threatening the Northern Pass has been slain.

narration_hooks.template: Trade resumes along the Northern Pass as the dragon's reign of terror ends.
News of the dragon's defeat spreads far and wide, bringing hope to all who heard it.

name: Master of Shadows
description: The hero has mastered the art of stealth and shadow.

narration_hooks.template: You move like a phantom, unseen and unheard.

name: Alliance of the Free Peoples
description: An alliance has been forged between the major factions.

narration_hooks.template: The banners of the alliance fly over every major settlement.
